clips.title: The story
paras: At Whelgar Excavation Site, Modr Fragment lies among the relics and loose earth of a raptor-overrun dig. The ancient Titan script on it is one of four missing pieces of the Goaz Stone.

Prospector Whelgar uncovered the Goaz Stone, a massive tablet marked with ancient Titan writing, at his Wetlands dig. Vicious raptors drove the Explorers' League from the site before they could finish their work. The translated inscription broke off at four gaps, hiding warnings of a divine plan and a doomed prophecy. Modr Fragment is one of the missing pieces, left among the relics and overturned soil when the diggers fled for their lives.
